map.模拟患者跌倒/坠床后的标准应急处理流程，逐步引导完成每个步骤。点击步骤可标记为完: Simulate the standard emergency response after a patient fall/bed fall, guiding each step. Click a step to mark complete.
map.发现患者倒地先评估意识与呼吸，禁止盲目扶起疑似骨折者。: On finding a fallen patient, first assess consciousness and breathing; do not blindly lift a suspected fracture.
map.疑有脊柱或髋部损伤者原位制动、呼叫医师与放射检查。: Suspected spine or hip injury: immobilize in place, call physician and radiology.
map.事件 24 小时内上报不良事件系统并填写根因分析。: Report to the adverse-event system within 24 hours and fill in root-cause analysis.
map.：输入场景=卫生间跌倒、意识清，工具给出制动—查伤情—通知医师—上报流程，与应急: : input scenario = bathroom fall, conscious; the tool gives immobilize - check injury - notify physician - report, consistent with the emergency manual.
map.本工具能替代现场抢救吗？: Can this tool replace on-site rescue?
map.不能，仅作流程提示，现场以医师判断与急救原则为准。: No, only a process reminder; on site follow the physician's judgment and first-aid principles.
map.患者要起身怎么办？: What if the patient wants to get up?
map.先安抚评估，无明显损伤征得医师同意后在旁协助缓慢起身。: First soothe and assess; if no obvious injury, with the physician's consent assist a slow rise.
map.跌倒属不良事件，上报用于改进环境与流程、降低再发风险。: Falls are adverse events; reporting improves environment and process and lowers recurrence risk.
